UPDATED: Cancelled Dual Purpose First Meetup – Bakfiets Unite!

December 7, 2023 • Adron

Egads, the weather!

Needless to say, because of the weather (?) the meetup was canceled on account of the underlying event cancellation. For more details, check out Move Redmond’s page here.

Past post below…

Coming up on the 13th and 14th of January, in this grand upcoming year of 2024, Move Redmond is organizing an event around station access mapping that to me, seems like bakfiets riders really need to be involved in! For more details from the Move Redmond emailer, check out this link.

I signed up for Saturday and Sunday, and wanted to open up the invite and maybe we could even make it a “Bakfiets Rider Gathering” and discuss the station access mapping and future meetups for riders. The specific times and locations I signed up for are…

Sat 1/13 10:00-12:00 @ South Bellevue, then Sunday 1/14 10:00-12:00 @ Overlake Village. I look forward to seeing others there, cheers!
